portfolio_role.summary: Measure and pressure responses under declared constraints, maintain falsifiable measurement candidates and evidence states, and consume exact upstream gonol representations without treating representation as measurement validity or silently inserting token, subword, opaque-vector, whole-string-hash, pairwise-sidecar, or intermediate-scale-reopening substitutions.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: EDCM consumes exact source evidence and pinned UCNS gonol receipts without inheriting their authority. The current upstream lexical sequence is characters -> morphology -> definitions -> recursive gonol relations, with xkcd 1,000 as floor candidate and OEWN 2025 Core as primary corpus. Relationships enter gonols and completed gonols are atomic at the next scale.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: EDCM emits measurement artifacts, experiment findings, receipts, and explicit evidence statuses that downstream systems may consume without upgrading them.

status.current_claim: EDCM supports represented, candidate-measured, and experiment-supported evidence in declared scopes; canon_selection remains null and empirical validation is not established. For language, EDCM is a downstream consumer of the current UCNS atomic lexical recursion: xkcd 1,000 floor candidate, OEWN 2025 Core corpus, characters -> morphology -> definitions -> recursive gonol relations, intrinsic semantic relationships, atomic closure, scale-invariant affixiation, and permitted direct interscale coupling. Historical NGSL and Scrabble planning no longer define the active source path.
